summary: Iter 243 verified: (1) Finance/Firewall unification (source='firewall_engine', identical health=92 and alerts count=3 on /api/finance/alerts and /api/firewall/dashboard), (2) health.breakdown key renamed 'audit_coverage' -> 'profitability' with block {revenue, expenses, net_income, margin_pct} present, (3) Bot Governance Phase C: supplier propose->awaiting_confirmation->'نعم'->committed and appears in GET /api/suppliers; customer propose->'لا'->cancelled with no side-effect; no-name guard (اضف مورد / سجل عميل جواله ...) asks for name and does not commit, (4) Four-Eyes UNCHANGED for expenses (pending_approval + approval_id), (5) Bot read consistency (كم عدد التنبيهات المالية؟ answers '3'), (6) Power-mode extraction correctly parses amount=4500 and phone=0555555555 (phone captured first). Frontend: login as مدير works; /operations shows alerts-health-chip='🛡️ 92/100' + alerts-toggle-btn + alerts-refresh-btn; /accounting/firewall renders gauge 92/100, chip 'الربحية' (no 'audit_coverage'), alert titles 'عمليات مالية' and 'عدم تطابق' both visible. 10/10 backend pytest passed.

issues: Health chip briefly shows nothing while fetching (~2-5s) — no skeleton/loading state; UX could add a shimmer for the chip. Not a blocker.

action_items: Optional UX: add loading skeleton to FinanceAlertsWidget (alerts-health-chip) to avoid the brief empty state during initial fetch.

Stale data cleanup (not a code bug): a pre-existing junk customer 'بدون اسم' (phone 0501001220, id ddbae1b7-4f00-4682-8396-23ca2f63b649) remains from an earlier session before the no-name guard existed. Consider a one-time DB cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceAlertsWidget: chip has 'title' tooltip 'درجة الصحة المالية — نفس مصدر جدار الحماية' — good indicator of unified source of truth to the user.
Chat response shape: /api/assistant/chat wraps the payload as {success, data:{response, executed, ...}}; front-end already relies on this; any test/consumer must use .data.*.
power/diagnose expects the key 'message' (not 'text'). Consider accepting both aliases for compatibility with power_mode helpers documented as text-based.
seed_data_creation: Test created several supplier records with prefix 'موردالاختبار<hex>' via bot commit flow. Cleanup fixture attempts DELETE /api/suppliers/{id} at end of module. No customers were committed by the test (customer flow used cancel or no-name).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_bot_governance_phase_c_iter243.py covers Finance/Firewall unification, breakdown key 'profitability', bot Phase C confirm/cancel/no-name guard, Four-Eyes for expenses, bot read consistency, and power-mode extraction. All 10 tests are green. Bot chat responses are enveloped as {success, data:{response, executed, ...}} — use the _chat_body() helper. Widget on /operations needs ~5-8s to fetch alerts before the chip populates; wait accordingly in Playwright.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Two initial test failures during authoring were due to (a) chat response envelope shape (data wrapper) — fixed by unwrap helper, (b) power/diagnose expects payload key 'message' not 'text' — fixed. Everything else passed first try. Frontend widget initial 'MISSING' in first Playwright pass was purely a race condition (widget still fetching); confirmed present with a longer wait.
